info.title: FieldOps API
info.description:
REST API for the FieldOps field-inspection platform.

Authenticate at `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, then send the returned access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Entity and inspection state diagrams are in `docs/api-diagrams.md`.

404.description: Inspection site or client not found

put.summary: Update and reorder a section in a draft inspection template

delete.summary: Delete a section from a draft inspection template

put.summary: Update and reorder an item in a draft template section

get.summary: List users with filters, sorting, and pagination
List inspection sites with name, client, and status filters
List inspections with filters, sorting, and pagination

post.summary: Schedule an inspection from an immutable template version
Reject an inspection under review with a mandatory reason
Cancel an inspection with a mandatory justification

422.description: Inspection cannot be canceled from its current status

get.summary: List inspection templates with filters, sorting, and pagination

post.summary: Create an inspection template in draft status
Create a section in a draft inspection template
Create an item in a draft template section
Publish an immutable inspection template version

get.summary: List equipment with site and status filters

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new access token
post.description: Renews an expired access token without re-prompting for credentials. The refresh token is an opaque UUID stored server-side (7-day expiry) and is not rotated.

401.description: Refresh token missing, expired, or invalid

post.summary: Invalidate a refresh token, ending the session
post.description: Deletes the stored refresh token so it can no longer renew access tokens. Idempotent: an unknown token also returns 204.

post.summary: Authenticate and obtain access and refresh tokens

patch.summary: Activate or deactivate an inspection site

get.summary: Check whether an email can be assigned to a user
List all equipment belonging to an inspection site
Get the audit timeline (state-change history) of an inspection
List published versions of an inspection template
Preview an inspection checklist and its publication issues
Find equipment by its unique QR code
List inspection sites belonging to a client
